name: Mimarchy
author: Diego Huyke
description: ARGB lighting for CPU cooler fans and GPU and the cooler's built-in display — one icon and one panel, sensors a hover away.

barWidget.description: Per-zone lighting effect, colour and speed, plus the cooler display — one icon and one panel; sensors on hover.

schema.label: Show temperatures in the tooltip
